items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1, allowing attackers to switch customer sessions.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update addresses critical and important vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect-authorization vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin addresses 13 vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-48358, a critical unauthenticated, zero-interaction flaw in the webhooks component that can lead to arbitrary code execution (CVSS 10.0).

items.title: Vulnerability allowing malicious file planting
items.summary: A high-severity vulnerability (CVSS 9.6) that allows an attacker to plant malicious files on the server.

items.title: Privilege escalation / feature bypass vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) enabling privilege escalation or security feature bypass.

items.title: Privilege escalation / feature bypass vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity vulnerability (CVSS 8.6) enabling privilege escalation or security feature bypass.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw (CVSS 9.3) in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie.

items.title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') in Modern Minds Magento 2 WordPress Integration
items.summary: A stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 5.9) in Modern Minds Magento 2 WordPress Integration m2wp allows attackers to inject malicious scripts.
